events.title: 'Imagine' 51st Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', its message of peace and unity still resonates. What's your favourite track from this legendary album?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician, singer-songwriter, and former Police frontman Sting celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo career, what's your ultimate Sting anthem?

events.title: The first iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary iPod a quarter of a century ago, fundamentally changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the pure joy of your first iPod? 25 years since its launch, it truly changed the game for music lovers everywhere. What was the first song you downloaded?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the enduring legacy of 007 and the anniversary of the first film's premiere.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment or film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His impact on the world is simply immeasurable.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian, actor, and screenwriter John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: A Very Silly Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us countless comedic masterpieces. What's your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: We remember the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who tragically passed away 35 years ago today at the age of 45.

angles.name: A Voice Unmatched
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a true legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. His music lives on.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! This Beatles album marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this influential record?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who was tragically taken from us 46 years ago today.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. We remember a true icon.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy at 80
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the unparalleled artistry of David Bowie. A true chameleon of rock whose influence is still felt today.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Celebrating the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy 92nd heavenly birthday to the King, Elvis Presley! His music continues to move generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God at 83
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod at 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! With a career spanning decades, what's your go-to Rod Stewart singalong?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness for Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the inimitable Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us joy for decades. What's your favourite Madness hit?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's 80s Vibe
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined many an 80s soundtrack. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?
